text.3:5: Lo! nothing in the earth or in the heavens is hidden from Allah.
text.14:38: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.
text.40:16: The day when they come forth, nothing of them being hidden from Allah. Whose is the Sovereignty this day? It is Allah's, the One, the Almighty.
text.41:40: Lo! those who distort Our revelations are not hid from Us. Is he who is hurled into the Fire better, or he who cometh secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do what ye will. Lo! He is Seer of what ye do.
text.69:18: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.
text.87:7: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;
